description: Defines an abstract class 'Downloader' for handling file downloads with progress tracking, hashing, and interruption support in an Android/Kotlin project.

classes.name: Downloader
classes.description: An abstract class providing download functionality with progress reporting, hashing, and cancellation support.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Abstract method to start the download process.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain an InputStream for the download.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Open suspend function to get bytes from the source, not implemented here.

methods.name: totalDownloadSize
methods.description: Abstract method to get total size of the download.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the remote file has changed.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets a progress listener for download progress updates.

methods.name: downloadFromStream
methods.description: Downloads data from an InputStream to a file, with interruption and progress support.

methods.name: downloadFromBytesReceiver
methods.description: Downloads data using a BytesReceiver, with hashing and progress reporting.

methods.name: copyInputToOutputStream
methods.description: Copies data from InputStream to OutputStream, updating progress and hash.

methods.name: reportProgress
methods.description: Reports download progress if enough time has passed.

methods.name: wasCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the download was cancelled.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfInterrupted
methods.description: Checks for cancellation and throws InterruptedException if cancelled.

methods.name: File.initDigest
methods.description: Extension function to initialize MessageDigest with file contents.
